notes.title: 🔥🔧New Mission Pack! 🔧🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Workshop Enthusiasts! 🛠️[/h1]

[h3]We’ve prepared another exciting set of challenges for you! In this latest update, we’re adding a brand-new mission pack, featuring three unique items to restore. This is a perfect opportunity to test your skills and bring a new life to some incredible antique tools![/h3]

[h3]🆕 What’s inside this pack?[/h3]

🔹 [b]Hand Cranked Grinder[/b] – A classic hand-powered grinder that was once essential for sharpening tools with precision. Now, its mechanism is rusted, and the wooden parts need restoration. Can you bring it back to its former glory?

🔹 [b]Cigar Cutter[/b] – An elegant and precise tool for cigar enthusiasts. Over time, its blades have dulled, and the metal parts have developed a patina. Only true restoration masters will be able to return it to its perfect state!

🔹 [b]MultiTool[/b] – A versatile, all-purpose tool that has seen years of use and now requires thorough repairs. With jammed hinges, worn-out blades, and dirty components, will you be able to make it function like new again?

[h3]🛠️ New challenges ahead![/h3]

Each of these items requires different restoration techniques. This is your chance to refine your skills and return to the workshop with fresh goals to accomplish!



📢 Let us know which item was the biggest challenge for you!

🎮 Roll up your sleeves and get to work – the new missions are waiting! 💪🚀

~ VR Factory Team

notes.title: 🔤 9 Language Update! 🌍🎙️
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Workshopers! 🛠️[/h1]

[h3]We're bringing you a language update to make your gameplay even more immersive and accessible to players worldwide! 🌎✨[/h3]

[h3]🆕 What's New?[/h3]

✅ [b]Text translations[/b]– new language versions for the interface, descriptions, and dialogues throughout the game. Now, even more players can enjoy the full experience!

✅ [b]Voice-over translations[/b]– we've added dubbing in selected languages to make missions and interactions feel even more realistic. Hear the new level of immersion! 🎙️🎧

[h3]Supported Languages:[/h3]
- English
- Polish
- Japanese
- Korean
- Spanish
- Latin American Spanish
- Italian
- French
- German


🌍 Accessibility for Everyone – as the game evolves, we want it to be understandable and enjoyable for players across the globe.

📢 Got a language suggestion? Let us know, and who knows – it might appear in the next update!

🎮 Jump into the game and explore the new translations! 🔥

~VR Factory Team

notes.title: 🔧 Bug Fixing Update! 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Workshopers! 🛠️[/h1]

[h3]A new update packed with fixes and improvements![/h3]

[h3]Check out what's changed:[/h3]

✅ [b]Mission completion animation[/b]– instantly see how much you earned!

✅ [b]Improved immersion[/b]– pick up the package again before cutting it open.

✅ [b]Better screw highlighting[/b]– now with arrows 🔼🔽 to show if they’re screwed in or out.

✅ [b]New tray shape[/b]– improved grip for the tray and objects.

✅ [b]Update info board[/b]– always stay up to date with the latest changes!

✅ [b]Larger item selection area[/b]– easier interaction with the computer.

✅ [b]Object teleportation[/b]– no more getting stuck inside the package outline!
__


🎮 Jump into the game and check out the new fixes! 💪🔥

~VR Factory Team

notes.title: 🔧 Bug Fixing Update! 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Workshop Enthusiasts! 🛠️🎨[/h1]

[h3]A new update full of fixes and improvements has just landed in the game! We want to make your experience even better, so we’ve fine-tuned some important gameplay aspects:[/h3]

✅ [b]Better interaction[/b]– increased remote grab range and item slot placement to make interactions more intuitive. 🤏

✅ [b]Easier assembly[/b]– the first element to insert is now clearly marked, so you always know where to start. 🧩

✅ [b]More readable progress bars[/b]– now in green, so you’ll never think you’re doing something wrong! 💚

✅ [b]Clearer stars[/b]– black stars on a green background = better visibility. ⭐

✅ [b]Returner system fix[/b]– single-piece items will no longer fall off the map. 🔄

✅ [b]More satisfying polishing[/b]– brush balancing adjusted for smoother work. 🛠️

✅ [b]Updated store links[/b]– check out our other games and try them for free! 🎮

__


Thank you for your feedback and support! 💚 Let us know what you think about this update and what else you'd love to see in the game! 🚀

Good luck in the workshop, and have fun!

~VR Factory Team🚀
